candidates.verified_fact: White, Grey, Black and Under Review classifications can incorporate both current infrastructure and credible build expected within the next three years.
candidates.use_rule: Never convert Grey/Black/Under Review directly into a current-service parcel value without a separate current-only field or Ofcom current coverage evidence.

candidates.verified_fact: ONS provides definitive current names, codes and lookups for UK administrative and statistical geographies via the Open Geography portal.
candidates.use_rule: Normalize LAD/region codes against current ONS references before joining BDUK regional/LAD files; do not derive broadband values from the lookup.

candidates.verified_fact: BDUK states its premises base differs from Ofcom's, including treatment of child premises such as apartments in houses of multiple occupation; suppliers and reference dates can also differ.
candidates.use_rule: A BDUK/Ofcom mismatch is not automatically a data error; compare only after premise-base, supplier-response and reference-date normalization.

candidates.verified_fact: PND 2026 uses the same premise base as Spring 2026 for coverage percentages, but its results describe planned deployments through January 2029 and headline results are residential-focused.
candidates.use_rule: Use only for future-growth/change context; never overwrite January 2026 current parcel availability.

operations.evidence: Grey/Black can mean available OR planned within three years; Under Review can include unverified current or risky planned claims.
